privacy_policy_intro: OpenAthlete helps coaches and athletes collaborate. We use artificial intelligence to analyze training data, surface insights that help prevent injuries, and assist in planning and modifying training plans. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.
privacy_policy_data_we_collect_list_2: Profile information (sport preferences, roles, timezone, language).
privacy_policy_data_we_collect_list_3: Training and activity data (planned sessions, completed activities, metrics, notes).
privacy_policy_data_we_collect_list_4: Device and connector data from integrated providers such as Garmin or Strava (activity files, GPS, heart rate, power, cadence, sleep, steps, body composition, wellness metrics), when you connect those services.
privacy_policy_data_we_collect_list_5: Health-related data that you choose to share (e.g., heart rate, HRV, VO₂max, injuries), which we treat as sensitive information.
privacy_policy_data_we_collect_list_7: AI interaction data (questions, prompts, model outputs) to provide and improve AI-assisted features.
privacy_policy_data_we_collect_list_8: Usage, diagnostics, and device information (logs, browser, IP, app performance) to maintain security and reliability.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_list_1: Provide the core service, including planning, tracking, and collaboration between coaches and athletes.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_list_2: Analyze and help modify training plans using AI, including insights to help reduce injury risk and optimize performance.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_list_3: Sync with connected providers (e.g., Garmin) to import activities and export workouts with your authorization.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_list_4: Communicate with you (service messages, notifications) and provide support.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_list_5: Maintain security, prevent abuse, and debug issues.
privacy_policy_how_we_use_list_6: Research and product improvement using aggregated or de-identified data whenever possible.
privacy_policy_legal_basis_list_1: Consent: for connecting third-party providers, processing sensitive health data, and receiving certain communications.
privacy_policy_legal_basis_list_2: Contract: to deliver the service you request and manage your account.
privacy_policy_legal_basis_list_3: Legitimate interests: to secure our services, prevent misuse, and improve features in a way that does not override your rights.
privacy_policy_sharing_list_1: Service providers (data hosting, analytics, customer support, AI infrastructure) under data processing agreements.
privacy_policy_sharing_list_2: Integrations you choose to connect (e.g., Garmin, Strava). We share or receive data strictly to provide the requested functionality.
privacy_policy_sharing_list_3: Coach–athlete collaboration: data you explicitly share within a space (e.g., plans, comments, metrics) is visible to invited members according to your settings.
privacy_policy_sharing_list_4: Legal compliance or to protect rights, safety, and security when required by law or to prevent fraud or abuse.
privacy_policy_data_retention_content: We keep personal data only as long as necessary to provide the service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. You may request deletion; some records may be retained as required by law or for legitimate business purposes.
privacy_policy_security_content: We apply administrative, technical, and organizational measures to protect personal data, including encryption in transit, access controls, and monitoring. No system is 100% secure; we continuously improve our safeguards.
privacy_policy_international_transfers_c: If data is transferred internationally, we rely on lawful mechanisms (e.g., Standard Contractual Clauses) and implement appropriate safeguards.
privacy_policy_your_rights_list_1: Access, correction, deletion, and portability of your data.
privacy_policy_your_rights_list_2: Restriction or objection to certain processing, including withdrawals of consent at any time.
privacy_policy_your_rights_list_3: Right to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority.
privacy_policy_children_content: OpenAthlete is not intended for children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has provided personal data, contact us and we will take appropriate action.
privacy_policy_changes_content: We may update this policy to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will post updates with a new effective date.
privacy_policy_contact_content: If you have questions or requests regarding privacy, contact us at contact@openathlete.org.

landing_topbar: Plan freely. AI optimizes and secures your progress.
landing_hero_subtitle: The co-pilot that adapts your training to your real fatigue and generates custom sessions on demand. Stay in control, secure the load.
landing_integrations_note: Built in Grenoble · Data hosted and processed in EU · Using French AI models.
landing_problem_point_1: Daily reality: Late meetings, travel... Your static plan can't adapt on its own.
landing_problem_point_2: Constant doubt: Should you maintain this VMA session when you're tired? Traditional tools don't answer.
landing_problem_point_3: Lost time: Spending 20 minutes manually building a complex interval session.
landing_solution_item_1: Adaptation, not imposition: You or your coach build the plan. AI suggests modifications if the load becomes risky.
landing_solution_item_2: On-demand generation: Need a specific session? Describe it, AI builds it instantly.
landing_solution_item_3: Active safety: A vigilance system that monitors your fatigue and suggests lightening the program before injury.
landing_how_step_1: Define your structure: Place your sessions or import a template plan. You remain in control.
landing_how_step_2: Connect your ecosystem (Strava, Garmin...). AI retrieves your history and calibrates your zones.
landing_how_step_3: Let AI secure: If your fatigue increases or a session is missed, AI immediately suggests a readjustment.
landing_how_step_4: Save time: Use the AI generator to create complex sessions in 3 seconds.
landing_how_step_5: Progress sustainably: The prevention engine detects overloads before they become pain.
landing_benefits_item_1: For self-coached athletes: The freedom to make your plan, with the safety of an expert validating the load.
landing_benefits_item_2: Creative time savings: 'Generate me a 1h30 threshold bike session'. Done, ready to export.
landing_benefits_item_3: For Coaches: Stop spending your Sundays rescheduling sessions. AI handles minor surprises, you manage performance.
landing_benefits_item_4: Human Feedback: Natural voice interaction to qualify raw data.
landing_features_card_1_desc: Slept poorly? Missed a session? AI recalculates the impact and suggests lightening or rescheduling what's next.
landing_features_card_2_desc: Simply describe your wish: '45min running session with 10min of 30/30'. AI creates the structured, exportable session.
landing_features_card_3_desc: Rigorous load tracking (CTL/ATL/TSB) and detection of weak signals of overload or under-recovery.
landing_features_card_4_desc: Stop checking boxes. Record a post-session voice note: AI analyzes your tone, stress, and motivation.
landing_features_card_5_desc: Have a coach? They access your data to validate AI adjustments. Are you a coach? Supervise more athletes.
landing_features_card_6_desc: Automatic centralization: Strava, Garmin, Suunto, Polar, Coros and Oura (coming soon).
landing_science_text: OpenAthlete doesn't replace your methodology. It acts as an assistant physiologist that monitors external load (W/kg, Pace) and your internal response (RPE, Heart Rate Variability). It validates the consistency of your planning and alerts you only when you leave optimal progression zones.
landing_pilot_item_2: Early detection of 8 out of 10 potential injuries.
landing_pilot_item_3: Average time savings of 2h/week on session creation.
landing_pilot_item_4: Massive adoption of voice feedback by users.
landing_testimonials_item_1_quote: I like making my own plan, but I often burned out. OpenAthlete serves as my safety net: when it tells me to slow down, I listen.
landing_testimonials_item_2_quote: The prompt feature is brilliant. I type 'Active recovery bike session 1h' and boom, it's in my Garmin calendar.
landing_testimonials_item_3_quote: For my athletes, it's a huge time saver. They fill in their availability, I set the key sessions, and AI handles the basic filling.
landing_pricing_subtitle: Cutting-edge technology to secure and facilitate your training.
landing_pricing_note: 14-day free trial on Pro and Ultra plans. VAT included.
landing_faq_item_1_q: Will AI change my entire plan?
landing_faq_item_1_a: No, never without your agreement. AI suggests modifications (e.g., lower intensity Tuesday because you're tired), but you validate or reject each proposal.
landing_faq_item_2_q: How does the AI generator work?
landing_faq_item_2_a: In the editor, simply type your idea (e.g., '3x10min at threshold, 2min recovery'). AI builds the blocks, calculates the load and adds it to the calendar.
landing_faq_item_3_q: Can I use it alongside my coach?
landing_faq_item_3_a: Yes. It's a dialogue tool. Your coach makes the plan, AI helps adjust it daily according to your circumstances, and the coach keeps the overall vision.
landing_faq_item_4_a: At minimum, your watch data (via Strava/Garmin). The more info you provide (RPE, sleep, stress), the more relevant the adaptation suggestions.
landing_faq_item_5_a: For the sovereignty of your health data and model quality, trained specifically on proven training methodologies.

tools_description: Free tools for runners and coaches to calculate training metrics and optimize performance.
tool_vma_description: Calculate your Maximum Aerobic Speed (VMA) from a time trial or race performance. Essential for creating effective training plans.
tool_vma_explanation_content: Maximum Aerobic Speed (VMA) is the minimum speed at which maximum oxygen consumption (VO₂max) is reached. It's a fundamental metric in endurance training, used to determine training intensities and create effective training plans.
tool_vma_how_to_demi_cooper: Demi-Cooper Test (6 minutes): Run as far as possible in 6 minutes on a track or flat course. Enter the distance covered.
tool_vma_how_to_cooper: Cooper Test (12 minutes): Run as far as possible in 12 minutes. Enter the distance covered.
tool_vma_how_to_race: Race Performance: Enter your race time and distance (5km or 10km). The calculator uses an approximation formula for race performances.
tool_vma_training_content: Once you know your VMA, you can determine your training paces: Endurance (65% of VMA), Threshold (85% of VMA), and VMA intervals (100% of VMA). These zones help structure your training sessions effectively.
tool_race_predictor_description: Predict your race time based on a previous performance using the Riegel formula. Estimate your marathon time from a 10km or half-marathon result.
tool_race_predictor_warning_content: This calculation assumes you have followed specific training for the target distance. The prediction is an estimate and may vary based on training, conditions, and individual factors.
tool_race_predictor_explanation_content: The Riegel formula is a mathematical model used to predict race times at different distances based on a known performance. It uses an exponential factor (1.06) that accounts for fatigue accumulation over longer distances. This formula is widely used by runners and coaches to estimate race times and set training goals.
tool_race_predictor_how_to_content: Enter your best recent performance (distance and time) as a reference. Then enter the distance you want to predict. The calculator will estimate your time and target pace. Remember that this is an estimate - actual performance depends on training, race conditions, and individual factors.
tool_heart_rate_description: Calculate your heart rate training zones using the Karvonen formula. Essential for beginners and health-focused training.
tool_heart_rate_input_max_hr_optional: Max Heart Rate (optional, calculated if not provided)
tool_heart_rate_explanation_content: Heart rate zones help you train at the right intensity. Each zone targets different physiological adaptations. Zone 2 (Aerobic Base) is ideal for fat burning and building endurance without excessive fatigue.
tool_heart_rate_karvonen_content: The Karvonen formula calculates target heart rate based on your heart rate reserve (the difference between max and resting heart rate). This method is more accurate than using percentages of max heart rate alone, as it accounts for individual differences in resting heart rate.
tool_heart_rate_how_to_title: How to measure your resting heart rate?
tool_heart_rate_how_to_content: Measure your resting heart rate first thing in the morning, before getting out of bed. Take your pulse for 60 seconds or count for 15 seconds and multiply by 4. Do this for several days and take the average for the most accurate result.
tool_heart_rate_zones_explanation: Zone 1 (50-60%): Active recovery, very light effort. Zone 2 (60-70%): Aerobic base, fat burning, comfortable pace. Zone 3 (70-80%): Aerobic, moderate effort. Zone 4 (80-90%): Threshold, hard but sustainable effort. Zone 5 (90-100%): VO₂max, maximum effort, very hard.
tool_heart_rate_zone_2_note: ⭐ Ideal for fat burning and building endurance
